stdout:
usage: research_artifacts.py [-h]
                             {init,validate,audit,render,resume,update} ...

Offline artifact bookkeeping. No network, model calls, or shell execution.

positional arguments:
  {init,validate,audit,render,resume,update}
    init                Create a new run without overwriting anything
    validate            Check structure, IDs, hashes and recorded quality
                        prerequisites
    audit               Separate deterministic checks from semantic
                        verification
    render              Render inert Markdown from structured artifacts
    resume              Detect changed inputs and invalidate dependent
                        conclusions
    update              Merge an explicit single-writer JSON bundle

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
